source.name: About FIBA: "Kuehne+Nagel continues as FIBA's Official Global Logistics Supplier with a partnership extension of three years"
source.quote: FIBA has agreed a partnership with Kuehne+Nagel to continue as FIBA Official Global Logistics Supplier for another three years.

note: FIBA's Official Global Logistics Supplier, extended for three years: a supply deal.
